label: Diagram 3
caption: Diagram 3 Relationship of ramp gradient to the going of a flight
description: Diagram 3 is a line chart titled "Relationship of ramp gradient to the going of a flight". The vertical axis is labelled "Gradient of ramp" and is marked, from bottom to top, 1:10, 1:12, 1:15 and 1:20, with unlabelled ticks between them. The horizontal axis is labelled "Going of ramp flight (m)" and is marked 0, 2, 5 and 10, with unlabelled ticks between. A single straight line runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. Three solid dots sit on the line, each joined by dotted lines to both axes. The first, at a going of 2 m, aligns with a gradient of 1:12 and is annotated "(166mm rise)". The second, at a going of 5 m, aligns with 1:15 and is annotated "(333mm rise)". The third, at a going of 10 m, aligns with 1:20 and is annotated "(500mm rise)".
